name: storage-cliff-v1
description: Destructive NVMe pSLC cliff characterization. Sequential write with 10 s fio bandwidth interval capture to expose cache exhaustion and sustained post-cliff write speed. CAUTION: overwrites all data on the DUT. Requires --destructive flag and serial re-entry confirmation.

phases.name: baseline
phases.notes: 15 s idle baseline. SMART, OCP, and NVMe identity artifacts captured at run start.

phases.name: cliff-write
phases.notes: 30 min sequential write. fio status intervals are collapsed into 10 s windows to quantify the pSLC write cliff.

phases.name: cooldown
phases.notes: 3 min cooldown. End-of-run SMART and OCP snapshots captured for comparison.
